_source: docs/design-bible.md: Thils's Vault: relics, Loot defaults. Names, builds and effects only; the Lost by column stays out of the app. Tags are proposed weighting tags (Loot defaults: Relic weighting).

relics.name: Travert's tuning gauntlet
relics.dormant: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon or unarmed strike, an echo hits another creature within 10 ft of the target for half the damage, as force.
relics.woken: The echo hits every enemy you choose within 10 ft of the target, and a creature dropped by an echo echoes again from its own space.

relics.name: Elemain's ricochet ring
relics.dormant: Once per turn, a ranged hit bounces to a second creature within 15 ft for half damage.
relics.woken: Bounces up to PB times, each to a new creature. Each bounce rolls a d20 and is a critical hit on a 20.

relics.name: The Reaper's toll
relics.dormant: Once per turn, when you drop a creature, teleport up to 30 ft to a space within 5 ft of another enemy. Your next attack against it has advantage.
relics.woken: That attack is a critical hit if it hits, and the chain repeats up to PB times per turn.

relics.name: Lenn's plumb line
relics.dormant: You know the HP of any creature that fails a save against your spell, and it has disadvantage on its next save against your spells before the end of your next turn.
relics.woken: Creatures Charmed, Frightened, Restrained or Incapacitated by your spells take PB d8 psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.

relics.name: Corrow's fishhook
relics.dormant: When a creature fails a save against your spell, or you grapple it, pull it up to 15 ft toward you or toward a point in the spell's area.
relics.woken: Once per turn, every creature that fails a save against your area spell is pulled to its center and can't take Reactions until its next turn.

relics.name: Thalisane's shuttle
relics.dormant: As a Bonus Action, link yourself to one ally or companion for 1 hour. Either of you can split damage taken between you, and when either regains HP, the other regains half as much.
relics.woken: Link up to PB creatures. Once per day, when a linked creature would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 instead and every linked creature regains 5 × PB HP.

relics.name: Zolic's ninth eye
relics.dormant: Your hits against Large or larger creatures deal +PB damage. Each time a creature you can see uses a Legendary Action or Resistance, gain an Eye (up to 9, lost after combat) that adds +1d4 to your hits against it.
relics.woken: At 9 Eyes, your next hit against that creature is a critical hit that ignores resistance and immunity, and your Eyes reset.

relics.name: Breaker's wraps
relics.dormant: While Bloodied, your weapon and unarmed hits deal +PB damage, you have +10 ft speed, and you can't be Frightened.
relics.woken: While Bloodied, you make one extra attack when you take the Attack action, and your critical hits restore 2 × PB HP.

relics.name: The Gleam Dealer's deck
relics.dormant: At dawn, draw PB cards. After any creature you can see rolls a d20, spend a card to add or subtract 1d6.
relics.woken: Once per day, call double or nothing on a d20 test you or an ally makes. On a success, an attack becomes a critical hit and any damage or healing is maximized; on a failure, you lose every card you hold.

relics.name: Pog's unfinished map
relics.dormant: You and allies within 30 ft ignore difficult terrain and can't become lost. You always know the way back to where you entered a place, and you have advantage on Initiative.
relics.woken: Once per day, cast Find the Path without components. It can find even the way out of a god's own labyrinth.

relics.name: The Sword of Apotheos
relics.dormant: A +2 longsword. When an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, your next hit before the end of your next turn deals +PB d8 radiant damage.
relics.woken: A +3 longsword. Once per day, become Apotheos for 1 minute: you're Large, have resistance to all damage, and your hits deal +PB d6 radiant damage.

relics.name: The Spellslinger's holster
relics.dormant: Once per turn, when your leveled spell hits or a creature fails its save against it, cast a cantrip you know as a Bonus Action.
relics.woken: That cantrip can target up to three creatures. Once per day, a single-target leveled spell you cast also hits a second target without a slot.

relics.name: The Express's pocket watch
relics.dormant: Each hit after your first in a turn deals +2 damage per earlier hit that turn.
relics.woken: Land 4 or more hits in a turn and the last pushes the target 15 ft and knocks it Prone, and your speed doubles until your next turn.

relics.name: The Glint's scabbard
relics.dormant: As a Bonus Action, sheathe and anchor. Until you draw, you can't attack but have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and each of your turns stores a weapon damage die (up to PB). Your first hit after drawing adds them.
relics.woken: Your draw strike teleports you to any creature within 60 ft and hits automatically, then you can return to where you started.

relics.name: The Collector's cage
relics.dormant: Your summons, familiar, companion and Wild Shape forms gain 2 × PB temp HP when they appear and deal +PB damage once per turn.
relics.woken: Once per day, when you cast a spell that summons one creature, a second copy appears with half its HP, and neither needs your Concentration.
